nav.offline: Offline: changes will sync when you reconnect

quickAdd.label: New task
quickAdd.readOnly: Read only: you are a viewer in this project
quickAdd.offline: New task… (sent when you are back online)
quickAdd.ambiguous: {{names}}: more than one person with that name. Pick one in the task details.

boss.defeatedUser: The next one arrives on Monday.
boss.defeatedClan: The whole clan got the reward. The next one arrives on Monday.
boss.label: Boss {{name}}: {{hp}} of {{max}} {{unit}}
boss.gameLink: Character, level, XP and boss of the week

today.title: Today
today.empty: Nothing for today. Enjoy your coffee.
today.emptyHint: Write "tomorrow", "friday" or "10/15" in the title to set a date.

page.resetDone: Checks reset. The history was kept.
page.emptyList: Nothing here yet. Type a task above, or paste a list.
page.emptyCards: Build the routine: paste the items, one per line.
page.emptyHabits: Add habits like "Drink water" or "Read 10 pages /mon,wed,fri".
page.emptyKanban: Empty board. Type a task above: it goes to "To do".

taskDetail.title: Task
taskDetail.repeatCycle: On this page the checks reset with the page cycle.
taskDetail.repeatNext: When completed, the date moves to the next time.
taskDetail.repeatNextNoDate: When completed, it gets the date of the next time.
taskDetail.deleteSubtasks: Its subtasks will be deleted too.

home.title: Home
home.inboxEmpty: Nothing loose: everything has a date or a folder.

hero.label: Character and boss of the week

mine.empty: Nothing assigned to you right now.
mine.emptyHint: In a shared project, write @name in a task to assign it to someone.

habits.title: Habits
habits.hintCheck: Done or not done for the day (or the week, the month).
habits.hintCounter: A goal per day: + adds, − undoes. Reaching the goal counts as done.
habits.hintPlusminus: No goal: + when you do the good one (XP and damage to the boss), − when you slip (the boss heals a little).
habits.syntax: Repeat in the text: /mon,wed,fri, /weekly, /monthly (nothing means every day). To change a habit's type later, open its details.
habits.empty: No habits yet. Pick the type above and write the first one.

folder.title: Folders
folder.emptyFolders: Create folders to separate topics (Gym, Home, Work…) and pages inside them.
folder.emptyFolder: A folder holds pages: a shopping list, a workout in cards, your habits.
folder.deleteMessage: Its subfolders, pages and tasks will be deleted too.
folder.deletePageMessage: The page's tasks will be deleted too.
folder.templateSaved: Template "{{name}}" saved. Use it in Folders → Use template.

pageDialog.cardsHint: Big cards to check quickly (workout, routine). Tap anywhere on the card.
pageDialog.habitsHint: Repeating items, with streaks and history.
pageDialog.kanbanHint: To do, Doing and Done columns. Good for projects with stages.
pageDialog.resetManual: Checks come back when you tap "Reset". The history is kept.
pageDialog.resetAuto: Checks come back on their own; the history is kept.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.timezoneHint: Sets when the day turns over for "Today" and "Overdue".

gameProfile.toggleHint: XP, level, character, boss and shop. When off, it disappears from the screen (the history is kept).
gameProfile.freezeOn: Weekly freeze available: one day without tasks won't break the streak.
gameProfile.freezeOff: This week's freeze has been used.
gameProfile.bossHint: Every task, habit and card is a hit; attributes and class change the damage (see Character). Winning raises the next one's level. If it escapes, the next one comes with no penalty.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.exportHint: Download everything that is yours: folders, pages, tasks, XP history, character and items, achievements and comments.
privacy.deleteHint: Deleting removes your folders and your history. Projects with other people stay with them (they go to the oldest member), and tasks assigned to you go back to being just your name.

push.title: Phone notifications
push.hint: When someone assigns you a task, mentions you or joins your project.
push.webHint: In the browser, notifications show up in the bell (in real time). The phone app can receive push.

character.title: Character
character.off: Gamification is off. Turn it on in Profile to get a character, boss and shop.
character.pickHint: Your class is your style: it changes your starting attributes and gives a passive and a daily skill. You can change it later, for free.
character.bossHint: Each win raises the next boss's level (level {{next}}: {{hp}} HP) and gives {{xp}} XP, gold and a random item. If it escapes, the next one comes with no penalty. Bad habits heal the boss.
character.activeUntil: Active until the end of the day
character.usedToast: {{name}}! Lasts until the end of the day.
character.damageHint: Crit: {{chance}}% chance. Gold per task: {{gold}}.{{first}} Damage = base × (1 + {{perPoint}}% per point of Strength on tasks or Intelligence on routines + passive and skill) × crit. A task completed right after it was created gives no XP, but the hit counts (up to {{cap}} damage a day).
character.firstStrikeNext: Your next hit is the first of the day: ×{{mult}}.

shop.title: Shop
shop.hint: Everything here is cosmetic: it doesn't change XP or damage. Earn gold by completing tasks and defeating bosses; some items only drop from bosses (the higher the level, the better the odds of a rare one).
shop.buyMessage: It costs {{price}} gold. You will have {{left}} left.

clan.title: Clan
clan.intro: Gather your friends in a clan: every week a group boss shows up, and every XP someone earns is a hit on it. Whoever helped gets the reward. No ranking of who fell behind.
clan.name: Clan name
clan.gotInvite: Got an invite? Open the link they sent you.
clan.leaveMessage: Your XP and achievements stay with you. You can join again with an invite.

projectBoss.title: Project boss
projectBoss.until: How long does the group have to finish everything?
projectBoss.intro: Call a boss with a deadline: every completed task is a hit, and everyone who helped gets the reward.
projectBoss.call: Call a boss with a deadline
projectBoss.giveUpMessage: It escapes with no penalty. You can call another one later.

board.nobody: Nobody has attacked yet. Be the first!
board.label: Boss highlights

auth.name: Your name
auth.taken: This email already has an account. Try signing in.
auth.short: The password needs at least 6 characters.
auth.tagline: Tasks, habits and projects, as quick as a notebook.

invite.askNew: Ask whoever invited you for a new link.
invite.createToJoin: Create your account (or sign in) to join.
invite.invited: You were invited to join as {{role}}.
invite.claimTitle: You're in! Which one are you on the list?
invite.claimHint: Some tasks were assigned before you arrived. Pick your name and they become yours.
invite.clanCalled: You were called to the clan.
invite.clanMembers_one: {{count}} person facing the boss of the week.
invite.clanMembers_other: {{count}} people facing the boss of the week together.
invite.otherClan: You are already in another clan. Leave it (Profile → Clan) to join this one.

share.title: Share
share.rootOnly: Only top-level folders can be shared.
share.linkHint: Whoever opens the link joins the project (and creates an account if needed). Valid for 14 days.
share.revoked: Link cancelled. Create another one whenever you want.
share.pendingHint: Tasks assigned to people who haven't joined yet. Whoever joins through the link picks their own name; you can also link them now.
share.removeMessage: Their assigned tasks go back to their pending name.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing here. When someone assigns you a task or mentions you, it shows up here.

capture.title: Quick capture
capture.help: Enter creates and stays here · Esc or tap outside to close · !! priority, #tag, tomorrow

batch.title: Add several
batch.noDraft: Open it from the page where you want to create the tasks.
batch.where: In {{page}} · one per line or separated by ";" · indent = subtask · [x] = already done
batch.placeholder:
Paste or type the list, for example:
meat; beer; charcoal
ice !!
- [x] invite everyone
